# OpenMiniLaunch / MinkLauncher source

Upstream: https://github.com/katoaapps/openminilaunch

Revision: `b9b26f733e1eb2e26dca1c7f816766332c6252ce` (2026-11-02).

The pure Kotlin calendar parser and its JVM tests retain their original package
and source. Messaging protocol helpers are attributed in their files. Grace's
command UI, keyboard routing and lifecycle are integrated separately; no upstream
branding, provider artwork, web search, AI, notes or to-do UI is included.

Source is Apache-2.0; see LICENSE and NOTICE. Copies are bundled in the APK under
`assets/licenses/openminilaunch/`. Grace's existing GPL-3.0 license is unchanged.
